172: async def stop_dynamic_service(
173:     node_uuid: NodeID,
174:     can_save: Optional[bool] = True,
175:     dynamic_services_settings: DynamicServicesSettings = Depends(
176:         get_dynamic_services_settings
177:     ),
178:     director_v0_client: DirectorV0Client = Depends(get_director_v0_client),
179:     scheduler: DynamicSidecarsScheduler = Depends(get_scheduler),
180: ) -> Union[NoContentResponse, RedirectResponse]:
181:     try:
182:         await scheduler.mark_service_for_removal(node_uuid, can_save)
183:     except DynamicSidecarNotFoundError:
184:         # legacy service? if it's not then a 404 will anyway be received
185:         # forward to director-v0
186:         redirection_url = director_v0_client.client.base_url.copy_with(
187:             path=f"/v0/running_interactive_services/{node_uuid}",
188:             params={"can_save": bool(can_save)},
189:         )
190: 
191:         return RedirectResponse(str(redirection_url))
